newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens unit sees higher 1996/97 sales.
newsitem.headline: Siemens unit sees higher 1996/97 sales.

text.p: The private communications group of electronics giant Siemens AG said on Wednesday it expected sales in the 1996/97 business year to rise to 10 billion marks ($6.4 billion) from 8.7 billion in the previous year.
"We have clearly beaten our targets and have grown much faster than the market as a whole," said Dietrich Botsch, president of the Private Communications Systems group.
"We are well on the way to meeting our target of becoming a 12 billion mark company by the year 2000."
Growth should come mostly from the United States and Asia in the mobile phones, corporate networks and corporate communications services businesses.
